properties.markdown:
## Yuma AI agent register and ISM evidence
Register metrics come from PB4 (daily). Evidence exports land in the evidence bucket under evidence/YYYY-MM-DD/ (PB5, monthly). Replace log group names before importing.

properties.title: A02 model use outside the register (last 24h)
properties.query: SOURCE '/yuma/bedrock/model-invocations' | fields identity.arn as principal, modelId | parse principal /assumed-role\/(?<role_name>[^\/]+)\// | lookup yuma_aia_register role_name OUTPUT agent_id | filter isempty(agent_id) | stats count(*) as calls by principal, modelId | sort calls desc | limit 20

properties.title: A01 shadow AI DNS (last 24h)
properties.query: SOURCE '/yuma/route53/resolver' | fields query_name, srcids.instance as instance | filter query_name like /(?i)(api\.openai\.com|api\.anthropic\.com|generativelanguage\.googleapis\.com|api\.mistral\.ai|api\.deepseek\.com|openrouter\.ai)\.?$/ | stats count(*) as queries by instance, query_name | sort queries desc | limit 20

properties.title: A11 MCP gateway tool calls by caller (last 24h)
properties.query: SOURCE '/yuma/cloudtrail' | fields additionalEventData.jwt.claims.sub as caller, requestParameters.body.params.name as tool | filter eventSource = "bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com" and eventName = "InvokeGateway" and requestParameters.body.method = "tools/call" | stats count(*) as calls, countDistinct(tool) as tools by caller | sort calls desc | limit 20

properties.title: A13 AI bots and MCP probes on public apps (last 24h)
properties.query: SOURCE 'aws-waf-logs-app' | fields httpRequest.clientIp as ip, httpRequest.uri as uri | filter @message like /bot:category:ai/ or uri like /(?i)^\/(mcp|sse|\.well-known\/(agent\.json|agent-card\.json|ai-plugin\.json))/ | stats count(*) as requests by ip | sort requests desc | limit 20
